scientific_integrity: The theorem is derived analytically. Exact finite-state checks corroborate per-petal absorption probabilities; simulated trajectories are illustrative, not proofs of limits. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed clique size m >= 3; n tends to infinity. Hub-started uniform neighbor rules, exact exclusion of the previous vertex for the nonbacktracking walk. No growing-m, finite-n ordering, or arbitrary-graph statement.
title: A sharp nonbacktracking cover-time law for clique windmills
